name: New Frontiers Ministers' Global Network (NFMGN)
mandate: A global mandate to raise spiritually grounded, mentally robust, and technologically empowered ministers for the next move of God.
convener: Pastor Dele Bamgboye is the Convener. His welcome: "We are not just a network; we are a company of visionary and purposeful agents of change. This is a community that provides a safe place for fellowship, connection & encouragement."
mission: To equip every minister with the spiritual, mental and technological resources for fulfilment of divine assignments.
story: Born out of a divine burden to mentor and father a new generation of leaders, NFMGN is an incubator for ministers who are hungry for a shift and continued relevance in the discharge of their God-given assignments. Special attention is also paid to balancing family life and ministry.
philosophy: The Frontier philosophy: the minister of the future must be as sound in the Spirit as they are savvy in leadership and technology.
pillars: Doctrinal Purity — empowered to live as the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus (2 Timothy 2:19–21)
Ministerial Integrity — standing firm on the unadulterated word of God (1 Peter 1:23–25)
Kingdom Exploits — constantly inspired to generate exploits in the pursuit of purpose (Psalm 18:29)
audience: Lead Pastors and Church Founders — building strong, grounded disciples, not just attendees; biblical depth, leadership clarity and practical discipleship frameworks.
Youth and Campus Ministers — raising spiritually rooted, purpose-driven young believers; discipling leaders beyond excitement into maturity.
Marketplace Apostles and Creative Ministers — entrepreneurs, professionals, artists, media creators and creative ministers aligning their calling with sound doctrine and practical discipleship.
onboarding: Application — fill out the onboarding form at /onboarding.html (six short sections: personal details, ministry profile, vision alignment, commitment & growth, references, declaration; about 10 minutes).
Vetting — a prayerful review by the leadership team.
Induction — receive a welcome pack and join the global community.
resources: Mentorship Archive — exclusive audio and video sessions from Pastor Dele Bamgboye (for members).
Minister's Handbook — downloadable guides on church administration and ethics (for members).
The Tech Hub — bridging the gap between the pulpit and the digital age (connected to HTECB).
events: Scale Session — direct mentorship sessions with the Convener.
Online Classroom — the monthly online course session.
The Quarterly Summit — a global gathering of ministers.
contact: Email info@newfrontiersglobal.online · Phone/WhatsApp +234 (0) 802 829 5917 · Website newfrontiersglobal.online. To book a meeting or apply, use the onboarding form at /onboarding.html.
unknowns: Dates, venues and times of upcoming events, membership fees or costs, and access details for member resources are not published on the website — the team confirms these directly.
